scenario_description:
Objective: Finish getting the Rainwake utility trailer from Fremont to Westlake for tonight’s practice after the tow run has begun.
Emerging Need: The drive reaches an active bridge-cone stop, and the same tow attempt cannot continue until a clearance-confirmed alternate route is chosen.
Decision Context: Early closure notices forbid guessing; the usable route choice depends on Elian’s saved tow-route note once SDOT opens a brief trailer window.
Consequence: If the route information is unavailable before the marshal window and dock unload cutoff pass, the trailer cannot enter tonight’s staging.

parameter.title: Tow Rainwake utility trailer to Westlake practice
parameter.description: Pick up the narrow utility trailer from Fremont storage and bring drums and spare dock bins to Westlake before evening practice staging.

parameter.subject: Fremont approach cone plan for evening bridge work
parameter.body: Maintenance crews expect intermittent east-approach closures near the Fremont Bridge beginning around 17:25. Trailer drivers should wait for a live marshal instruction if stopped at the cones; advance map detours are not approved before the cone stop because lane placement may change.

parameter.content: Status update: tow run started from Fremont, but I’m stopped at the east-approach cone with the narrow utility trailer and the engine off. Marshal says trailers cannot move until SDOT opens alternates, so I’m not taking random side streets from the map.

parameter.subject: Trailer alternate window now open at Fremont cone
parameter.body: For vehicles already held at the Fremont east-approach cone, a trailer alternate window is open from 17:40 to 17:50. Marshals will release a trailer only when the driver states a clearance-confirmed route from their own notes; SDOT will not choose between Queen Anne/Galer, Leary/8th, or other map side-street options.

parameter.content: Westlake gate crew starts dock staging at 18:05. If Elian’s trailer is not rolling from the cone by about 17:50, the drums stay at Fremont tonight. I’m setting my phone down for launch prep now.

parameter.subject: Westlake trailer unload gate closed
parameter.body: The Westlake trailer unload gate closed at 18:05 for tonight’s practice staging. Late trailers cannot enter the dock lane this evening because boats are already being moved to the float.
